name: Lizard Man of Scape Ore Swamp
description: The Lizard Man of Scape Ore Swamp is a reptilian humanoid cryptid reported around Bishopville, Lee County, South Carolina, after a 1988 encounter by a 17-year-old motorist named Christopher Davis. Subsequent reports of vehicle damage, footprints and brief follow-up sightings made it a national news story that summer.

aliases.name: Scape Ore Lizard Man
aliases.region: Scape Ore Swamp, South Carolina, USA

origin: Reports are tightly concentrated around Scape Ore Swamp and Browntown in Lee County, South Carolina, particularly along rural roads north of Bishopville.
